pair.carriageway: continuous accepted Durgam-to-Madhapur primary carriageway, called north carriageway in the researched east-west blocks
pair.sideConvention: LEFT/RIGHT relative to every saved directed forward road; cardinal orientation changes as the road bends. Opposite-carriageway shops are excluded.

existingPlanDiscovery.scope: Saved game research route/plan filenames, existing bounded work candidate packets, and survey-work-queue/network schema inspected. No active/owner-approved complete endpoint-to-endpoint research denominator was found. A separate supplementary complete derived geometry audit was supplied after initial derivation; it is independently reproduced here, not treated as approval.
existingPlanDiscovery.queueDisclaimer: Complete work inventory only. Generated research URLs do not prove available imagery. Partial observation windows do not imply all frontage within them is reconstructed or verified. Blocks are connected subsets of the canonical road graph; corridor labels are nearest-station work regions, not source verification.

start.selectionBasis: Nearest source primary one-way at-grade centreline progressing toward the other station along the accepted carriageway direction; physically nearer reverse carriageway excluded.
start.limitation: Saved OSM-derived station marker projection only; not a surveyed station gate, parking spot or validated pedestrian entrance. Offset from station marker excluded from driving length.

end.selectionBasis: Nearest source primary one-way at-grade centreline progressing toward the other station along the accepted carriageway direction; physically nearer reverse carriageway excluded.
end.limitation: Saved OSM-derived station marker projection only; not a surveyed station gate, parking spot or validated pedestrian entrance. Offset from station marker excluded from driving length.

routeMethod.algorithm: Shortest saved directed.next path between selected primary one-way at-grade endpoint projections; includes all accepted research corridor roads in order.
routeMethod.lengthBasis: Canonical saved road lengthM for complete edges and centreline geometric arclength projections for endpoint cuts. Source geometry is provisional; this is a planning distance, not field measurement.
routeMethod.drivabilityLimit: Every edge is graph-routable and connected. This task did not manually drive the pair or certify current collision clearance. Station doors/walking approaches were not established.

summary.coverageMeaning: Recorded observation windows include partial shop rows and fully inventoried non-shop median. They do not mean complete shop reconstruction or exact metric verification.

baseline43Comparison.authority: Supplementary derived data only; neither audit is a human-approved route denominator or imagery completion certificate.
baseline43Comparison.differenceExplanation: Core road.lengthM values are rounded to two decimals. Main report uses those saved canonical units for full edges and review bounds; independent audit uses direct geometric polyline lengths and clips review bounds to those lengths. Endpoint projections and ordered roads are identical.

precisionBasisComparison.note: The independent supplementary audit and its reviewed numerators apply to frozen43 only. Current coverage uses the unchanged canonical rounded-unit manifest with updated survey windows; no claim that old43 coverage equals this revision.

limitations: No new street views were inspected for this geometry-only task.
A source station marker projected to a carriageway is not a proven entrance or station dropoff.
Partial reviewed shop-side ranges remain incomplete; source-parent gaps including Madhapur Pride and unsupported canopy/booth/temple geometry remain unresolved.
Visual inventory is distinct from measured storefront placement; strict metric verification is zero.
Review windows are clipped to this one carriageway route, unioned per road and then along route offset. Neither overlaps nor opposite sides/counterpart carriageways multiply the numerator.
Current runtime geometry/survey/imports and prior delivery-route evidence were not changed or rerun.

coverageRefresh.scope: Only per-road survey windows, union counts/gaps and survey provenance refreshed. All28 roads, cuts, offsets, source geometry and projected station endpoints retained exactly.
